title: Nondegenerate bilinear form has nonzero Gram determinant
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $V$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], $\beta:V\times V\to K$ a bilinear form, and $b$ a basis of $V$ indexed by a finite type. If $\beta$ is nondegenerate, then the determinant of the Gram matrix of $\beta$ in the basis $b$ is nonzero.
